title: A failed create leaves its output truncated and without a header
body:
`SuffixArrayBuilder::build` in `libsufr/src/build.rs` opens the output with `File::create` before sorting, which truncates any existing file at that path, and writes the header last. A build that fails or panics in between leaves a file that does not open in place of what was there. Nobody has checked whether dev's builder before f085e43 did the same.

## Proposal

Write to a temporary name next to the output and rename it on success.
